entries.title: Psalms 80:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician upon Shoshannimeduth, A Psalm of Asaph.>> Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest [between] the cherubims, shine forth. {of: or, for}

entries.title: Psalms 80:2
segments: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come [and] save us. {come...: Heb. come for salvation to us}

words.text: us. {come...: Heb. come for salvation to us}

entries.title: Psalms 80:3
segments: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

entries.title: Psalms 80:4
segments: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people? {be...: Heb. smoke}

words.text: , how long wilt thou be angry

entries.title: Psalms 80:5
segments: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.

entries.title: Psalms 80:6
segments: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 80:7
segments: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

entries.title: Psalms 80:8
segments: ¶Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

entries.title: Psalms 80:9
segments: Thou preparedst [room] before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

words.text: it, and didst cause it to take deep

entries.title: Psalms 80:10
segments: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof [were like] the goodly cedars. {goodly...: Heb. cedars of God}

entries.title: Psalms 80:11
segments: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

entries.title: Psalms 80:12
segments: Why hast thou [then] broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

words.text: , so that all they which pass

entries.title: Psalms 80:13
segments: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

entries.title: Psalms 80:14
segments: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;

entries.title: Psalms 80:15
segments: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch [that] thou madest strong for thyself.

entries.title: Psalms 80:16
segments: [It is] burned with fire, [it is] cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 80:17
segments: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man [whom] thou madest strong for thyself.

entries.title: Psalms 80:18
segments: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

words.text: So will not we go back

entries.title: Psalms 80:19
segments: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
